findings: `learner.overview` should lead with the supported direct-numeral account: early forms are described as four marks used directly to write “four.” Then identify the counting-rod interpretation and the distinct, disputed borrowing proposals involving 呬 and 泗. The current overview makes the direct numeral account sound merely coequal with those alternatives. Cite X-118eac796eaf633cee01, X-59bc83330141db2f9d20, and X-4b62255296f832195814.
